article.story: HOUSTON -- — Mambourou Mara finished with 18 points and 11 rebounds to lead Houston Christian to a 108-73 victory over College of Biblical Studies on Friday night. Mara made 7 of 9 shots for the Huskies (4-0). D'Aundre Samuels had 14 points and seven assists and Bubz Alvarez scored 14 with five assists. Odis Carter Jr. had 26 points on 11-for-17 shooting to lead the Ambassadors, an NCCAA Division II school. Marquise Scott added 12 points. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
